sections.eyebrow: When WordPress is the right fit
sections.title: And when something else is better

items.label: You publish content regularly and want to manage it yourself.
You need many service and sector pages with the same structure.

items.question: Do you use a ready-made theme?
items.answer: No. Instead of installing a generic theme, we build blocks around your brand, so your pages stay editable without breaking the design.

items.question: How many plugins do you use?
items.answer: As few as possible, and only trusted ones, because too many plugins slow the site down and increase security risks.

items.question: Can I add pages myself?
items.answer: Yes. Pages are built from ready-made blocks that you put together yourself, without writing any code.

items.question: What about security and updates?
items.answer: We set up backups, user permissions and a security layer, and we can agree on monthly monitoring of updates.

items.question: Do you build multilingual WordPress websites?
items.answer: Yes, with the URL structure and language tags set up correctly for each language version.

items.question: Is WordPress a good choice for an online store?
items.answer: Yes, through WooCommerce. We have a separate page that explains how we build and set up WooCommerce stores.
